comparison.objective: Stand a lecture gas bottle upright in a bench clamp and lock the clamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually stabilize an unstable bottle while sliding a cross bolt and closing a cam lever.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle upright and centered, bolt home, lever locked, no toppling, released and still.
comparison.reason: This tests stabilization during clamp actuation. It does not test a moving component crossing a precision support interface or containment of loose internal elements.
